qualifier: via agonist receptor signalling (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, collagen)
name: Platelet activation and aggregation via agonist receptor signalling
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, adhesion, aggregation, degranulation or coagulation, and unlike the confusables (VWF variants, Rho/G12/13, cytoskeletal remodelling) the theme carries the agonist receptor routes: P2Y1/P2Y12, PARs, TP, GPVI and prostacyclin receptor.

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagic turnover
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly, lipophagy and triglyceride storage in fat cells, whereas confusables centre on triglyceride catabolism, synthesis or fatty acid oxidation without droplet organization and lipophagy.

name: Nuclear pore complex disassembly and reassembly
rationale: All three members concern nuclear pore complex disassembly or (re)assembly, distinct from confusables on nuclear lamina/envelope reformation and SUMOylation.

name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation and excitability
rationale: Members centre on MECP2 control and loss-of-function affecting neuronal receptors, channels and GABA genes, plus action potential, calcium channel and glutamate receptor regulation, whereas confusables add HDAC/NCoR repression and Rett-type behavioural and developmental terms.

core: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension
name: Non-canonical Wnt (PCP and calcium) signalling in convergent extension
rationale: Members cover planar polarity, PCP Wnt signalling and convergent extension in gastrulation and neural plate, and uniquely include the Wnt/Ca2+ branch that the axial-mesoderm, left-right and hedgehog confusables lack.

name: Nitrosative and oxidative stress control of intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members concern responses to nitric oxide, reactive nitrogen species, hyperoxia and peroxide that regulate intrinsic and neuronal apoptosis, whereas confusables focus on peroxide/HMOX1, ferroptosis or ischemia without the nitrosative and neuronal death components.

name: mRNA polyadenylation and decapping-dependent 5'-to-3' decay
rationale: Members cover mRNA cleavage/polyadenylation and deadenylation-independent decapping with 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay, unlike confusables on mRNA stabilization, deadenylation or histone mRNA processing.

name: Scavenger receptor uptake and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and scavenging by class A, B, F and H receptors (with AGE receptor and hyaluronan degradation), whereas confusables emphasize microglia, amyloid clearance and foam cells.

name: Lipoyl 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and vitamin B6-dependent serine-glycine metabolism
rationale: Members cover protein lipoylation, PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes, DLD, glycine cleavage and lysine catabolism plus serine and vitamin B6 metabolism, the latter distinguishing it from TCA and fatty acid oxidation confusables.

core: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
name: Visceral smooth muscle tone in micturition and peristalsis
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction and relaxation regulation with urinary tract contraction, micturition and peristalsis, distinguishing it from reproductive, gastric and vascular smooth muscle confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitochondrial RNA turnover
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, mtRNA stability and decay (FASTK), and mtDNA maintenance, whereas confusables centre on mitochondrial translation, RNA modification or mtDNA replication.

name: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability, decay and small-RNA silencing
rationale: Members cover ARE-binding protein decay/stabilization, deadenylation, decapping, polyadenylation and miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, unlike confusables on mRNA export, translation, splicing or transcription.

qualifier: by RNA polymerases II and III
name: snRNA transcription by RNA polymerases II and III
rationale: Members cover snRNA transcription by Pol II and Pol III (type 3 promoter, elongation, termination) and U6-containing snRNP formation, distinguishing it from tRNA-type Pol III and spliceosome confusables.

qualifier: gonad, germ cell, placenta and reproductive hormone signalling
name: Gonad, germ cell and placental development with reproductive hormone signalling
rationale: Members span gonad and germ cell development, ovarian follicle and oocyte maturation, trophoblast/placenta formation and gonadotropin/activin/progesterone signalling, whereas confusables cover glandular organs or meiosis, gametes and fertilization.

name: Self-nucleic-acid sensing via endosomal TLR7-9 and ADAR editing
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling regulation, TREX1 and ADAR A-to-I editing that restrain type I interferon responses, unlike confusables on cytosolic RIG-I/cGAS, PKR/OAS or TLR3 sensing.

name: B cell receptor signalling and its co-receptor tuning
rationale: All members concern BCR signalling (second messengers, BTK, RAS) and its positive/negative regulation including CD22 and leukocyte activation brakes, distinct from T cell costimulation and Fc receptor confusables.

name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytic recycling and neurotransmitter release control
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle endocytosis, clathrin uncoating, recycling and regulation of neurotransmitter secretion and uptake, distinct from active-zone, dendritic and catecholamine confusables.

name: TLR3-TRIF-driven necroptosis and TBK1-IRF3 activation
rationale: Members cover TRIF/TLR3-mediated and RIPK1 necroptotic death and TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/IRF7, distinct from caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis and TRIF-NF-kB confusables.

name: PIEZO1 mechanotransduction of shear stress and eNOS activation
rationale: Members cover PIEZO1-mediated responses to laminar/oscillatory flow and mechanical load together with eNOS activation, trafficking and NO production, combining what confusables split into mechanosensing alone or NO-cGMP signalling alone.

name: Brown and beige fat thermogenesis with fatty acid cycling
rationale: Members cover brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis with fatty acid transport and cycling, distinct from white adipogenesis and glycerol transport confusables.

name: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane cristae organization
rationale: Members cover protein import into mitochondria, cristae formation, outer membrane organization and fusion, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation and respiratory complex assembly.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, centromere and spindle checkpoint
name: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, centromere and spindle checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover cohesion establishment and resolution, CENP-A centromere assembly, chromosome condensation, spindle checkpoint and PLK1/AURKA mitotic regulation, distinct from cohesin loading, cytokinesis and centrosome confusables.

qualifier: G beta-gamma effectors and B cell receptor
name: G beta-gamma and B cell receptor second-messenger signalling to PKC
rationale: Members cover G beta-gamma signalling via PLC beta, BTK and PI3K gamma, PKC regulation and phorbol ester response together with BCR second messengers, the Gbg/PKC arm distinguishing it from BCR/CD22 and Fc receptor confusables.

name: Defective oxidative-damage DNA glycosylases in base excision repair
rationale: Members are defects of OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 substrate binding, processing or localization plus APEX1 displacement of glycosylases, distinct from confusables on downstream AP-site resolution, NEIL glycosylases and alkylation repair.

core: Reactive aldehyde detoxification and cofactor metabolism
name: Methylglyoxal-aldehyde detoxification and molybdenum/vitamin B6 cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification with protein/DNA glycation repair and molybdenum cofactor, vitamin B6 and sulfide oxidation prosthetic-group metabolism, distinct from sulfur amino acid, glutathione and lipoyl-dehydrogenase confusables.
